1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least two different bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptides.

2. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo and is functional for metabolic processing.

3. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme that catalyzes a specific metabolic reaction.

4. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes that act on various substrates.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence and is involved in a defined metabolic pathway.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides derived from more than one bacterial species.

9. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons and is tailored for efficient metabolic function.

11. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag for purification.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and at least one enzyme, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a functional proteinaceous shell.

21. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least two different bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptides and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a defined product. 

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of distinct compartments that provide diverse metabolic functions.
